verdict.rationale: First-party material describes Gitea as a free, MIT-licensed, self-hosted Git service with full control. It deploys as a single binary or official container image across Linux, Windows, macOS, FreeBSD, and Kubernetes, with single-server or replicated setups and SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL backends. Many independent hands-on reports corroborate painless installs, low resource use (from a $5 VPS to a Raspberry Pi), Docker setups, and simple binary-swap upgrades.
